Long leaf plant discovered in Karnataka
Butterfly species discovered in Tamil Nadu

questions.x: Subhash Palekar is known for promoting Zero Budget Natural Farming (ZBNF).

questions.s: As stated in the Preamble to the Constitution of India, India is a
questions.x: The Preamble describes India as a 'Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic'; 'Socialist' and 'Secular' were added by the 42nd Amendment, 1976.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: How many Fundamental Duties are stated in Article 51A of the Constitution ?
questions.x: Article 51A had 10 duties when added in 1976; the 86th Amendment (2002) added an 11th, the duty of parents to educate children aged 6 to 14.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: In India, any violation to the right to property cannot be challenged by filing a
o: Writ under Article 226 of the Constitution
Writ under Article 32 of the Constitution
questions.x: Since the 44th Amendment (1978) the right to property is a constitutional right under Article 300A, not a fundamental right, so it cannot be enforced through a writ under Article 32.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: According to Article 248 of the Indian Constitution, Residuary Power is vested with the
questions.x: Article 248 vests residuary legislative power in Parliament.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: How many times can a person be elected as the President of India ?
questions.x: Article 57 lets a person be re-elected as President, and the Constitution sets no limit on the number of terms.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: In which case did the Supreme Court deliver the landmark judgement dealing with imposition of President's Rule in the States ?
questions.x: In S.R. Bommai v. Union of India (1994) the Supreme Court set limits on imposing President's Rule under Article 356.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: For altering the boundary of a state or for creation of a new State,
o: Concurrence of the affected State Assembly is required
views of the affected State Assembly are to be sought by the President
Two-thirds majority of the affected State Assembly is required
Affected State has to make a recommendation to the Lok Sabha
questions.x: Under Article 3 the President refers the bill to the affected State Legislature for its views; Parliament is not bound by those views.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Which one of the following writs can be filed against a private person also ?
questions.x: Habeas corpus can be issued against both public authorities and private individuals who unlawfully detain a person.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: The day which is celebrated as the Constitution day in India is
questions.x: November 26 is Constitution Day, the day in 1949 the Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Which one of the following does not indicate a prominent federal feature of the Indian State ?
questions.x: Distribution of powers, an independent judiciary and a supreme written constitution are the classic federal features; allocation of financial resources is not one of them.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: In the words of K. C. Wheare, a constitutional expert, India is
questions.x: K.C. Wheare called the Indian Constitution 'quasi-federal'.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: In which year, did the right to education come into force as a fundamental right ?
questions.x: The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act came into force on 1 April 2010, making Article 21A operational.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: The reason for the Public Accounts Committee of Parliament being headed by a member of the opposition party in the Lok Sabha is
questions.x: The PAC chair goes to a member of the opposition by convention, a practice followed since 1967.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: How many members are from the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha respectively in the Parliamentary Committee on Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes ?
questions.x: The Parliamentary Committee on the Welfare of SCs and STs has 30 members: 20 from the Lok Sabha and 10 from the Rajya Sabha.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: The Model Code of Conduct for elections is issued by the Election Commission as per
o: Rules in the Indian Penal Code
Rules laid down in the Peoples Representation Act
questions.x: The Model Code of Conduct has no statutory backing; parties agreed to follow it voluntarily, and the Election Commission enforces it on that basis.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: President's Rule is declared under which Article of the Constitution ?
questions.x: President's Rule, when constitutional machinery in a State fails, is imposed under Article 356.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Article 32 of the Constitution
o: can be amended with simple majority
Can be amended with two-thirds majority
can be amended with ratification by the States
questions.x: Article 32 (the right to constitutional remedies) is part of the basic structure, so it cannot be amended away.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Which of these Fundamental Rights is available only to a citizen of India ?
questions.x: The Article 19 freedoms are available only to citizens; Articles 14, 21 and 25 also protect non-citizens.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: It is believed that Fundamental Duties have been introduced in the Constitution upon recommendation by this Committee
questions.x: The Swaran Singh Committee (1976) recommended Fundamental Duties, and the 42nd Amendment added them.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Decisions of Inter State Council are taken by
o: Simple majority from the members present
Two-thirds majority from the members present
Three-fourths majority from the members present
questions.x: The Inter-State Council takes decisions by consensus, with the Prime Minister's decision final on questions not settled that way.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution are adopted on the lines of the Constitution of
questions.x: The idea of Fundamental Duties was borrowed from the Constitution of the former USSR.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: In the case of Supreme Court Advocates on Record Association, which of the following judges upheld the Constitutional Amendment for creation of National Judicial Appointments Council ?
questions.x: In the NJAC case (2015) Justice J. Chelameswar was the lone dissenting judge who upheld the 99th Amendment.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: As recommended by Justice M.M. Punchhi Commission on Centre-State relations, the Governor of a State shall have
o: a tenure determined by the State Assembly
questions.x: The Punchhi Commission recommended a fixed five-year tenure for Governors, removable only by impeachment-like procedure rather than at pleasure.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: The following is not one of the Directive Principles in the Constitution
o: Equal pay for equal work of men and women
questions.x: Article 51 asks the State to promote international peace and security, not international trade; the other three are Directive Principles (Articles 48, 39(d) and 50).
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Which Article of the Directive Principles of the Constitution mentions about empowering Village Panchayats ?
questions.x: Article 40 directs the State to organise village panchayats and give them powers to function as units of self-government.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Who circulated a questionnaire on Uniform Civil Code in October, 2016 to solicit opinions from the public at large ?
questions.x: The Law Commission of India issued a questionnaire on the Uniform Civil Code on 7 October 2016.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: As per the Constitution, a Union Minister shall hold office during pleasure of the
questions.x: Under Article 75(2) Union Ministers hold office during the pleasure of the President.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: As per the Constitution, the Council of Union Ministers is collectively responsible to
questions.x: Under Article 75(3) the Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: In which category was Sachin Tendulkar nominated as the member of the Rajya Sabha ?

questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Whose decision is final in deciding whether a bill is a money bill or not ?
o: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha
questions.x: Under Article 110(3) the Speaker of the Lok Sabha decides finally whether a bill is a money bill.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Collegium system of appointment of Supreme Court Judges derives sanction from
questions.x: The collegium system comes from Supreme Court judgments (Second Judges case 1993, Third Judges case 1998), not from the text of the Constitution.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: If a bill is introduced in the Council of the State and sent to Legislative Assembly for approval but if the Legislative Assembly rejects the bill, what is the next course of action ?
o: Joint sitting of both the Houses
Council may send the bill back to the Assembly for reconsideration
Bill may be sent to the Governor for examination
The fate of the bill ends

questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: The total number of ministers including the Chief Minister in a State shall not be less than

questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: The remuneration of an Advocate General would be
o: Equal to that of a High Court Judge
Equal to that of the Chief Secretary of the State
Equal to that of the Cabinet Minister of the State
questions.x: Under Article 165(3) the Advocate General receives remuneration determined by the Governor.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: As per Article 243 of the Constitution, the following would be the members of "Gram Sabha"
o: All adults with age of 18 years and above in the Panchayat area
All voters as per electoral rolls relating to the Panchayat area
All citizens residing in the Panchayat
All persons allowed by the Gram Panchayat
questions.x: Article 243(b) defines the Gram Sabha as all persons registered in the electoral rolls of the village panchayat area.

questions.s:
Match the following Articles with the corresponding States :

C. Article 371C - R. Manipur
D. Article 371F - S. Mizoram
E. Article 371G - T. Sikkim

questions.x: Under paragraph 6 of the Fifth Schedule, the President declares and can alter Scheduled Areas.

questions.s: Even during Emergency, the following rights cannot be suspended
questions.x: Under the 44th Amendment, Articles 20 and 21 cannot be suspended even during an Emergency.

questions.s: What is the amount of grant-in-aid recommended by the 14th Finance Commission to the Panchayats during 2015 -2020 ?

questions.s: Cultivation of opium is an item in the

questions.s: The power of Parliament to amend the Constitution is limited by the

questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Which Article of the Constitution directs to provide instruction in mother tongue at the primary education stage to the children of linguistic minority groups ?

questions.x: Of the options, judicial review to enforce fundamental rights is exercised through Article 32.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: The aim of Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana is

questions.x: FlightStats' 2016 On-Time Performance awards named KLM the top major international airline for punctuality.

questions.s: Why did Alauddin Khilji introduce a market policy of fixed prices for food grains ?
o: For better return to the farmers
To ensure that consumers can directly purchase from farmers
To ensure that the market price is equal to the fair price
To ensure that soldiers can live comfortably with low salary

questions.s: The decline of trade and commerce in North India between 7th and 10th centuries was partly due to the

questions.x: Sher Shah Suri introduced the silver rupiya (about 178 grains), which remained a standard coin for centuries.

questions.s: The "Dahsala" system developed by Raja Todar Mal was for
o: Collection of revenue at standard rate which was valid for 10 years
Measurement of land once in 10 years for fixing area of assessment
Collection of revenue on the basis of average of produce and prices in the last 10 years
Sharing of crop between the farmer and the State for 10 years

questions.s: The class of traders who specialized in carrying bulk goods over long distances during Mughal period were called
questions.x: The Banjaras were caravan traders who moved bulk goods such as grain over long distances on pack bullocks.

questions.s: During Mughal period, approximately how much percentage of rural agricultural produce was marketed ?

questions.s: The Industrial Revolution in Britain led to
o: Increase in export of raw cotton from India
Increase in export of textiles from India
Liberalization of textile trade with India
No change in textile trade from India

questions.s: Which name is not associated with Green Revolution in India ?

Interest bearing borrowings during a financial year

is fully funded by respective State governments
